sloka: एवं वर्षसहस्राणि समतीतानि सुव्रत ।राज्यं कारयतो ब्रह्मन्प्रजा धर्मेण रक्षतः ।। ७.७८.६ ॥
transliteration: evaṁ varṣasahasrāṇi samatītāni suvrata ।rājyaṁ kārayato brahmanprajā dharmeṇa rakṣataḥ ।। 7.78.6 ॥

translations.english: O virtuous one, O Brahmana, thus thousands of years passed while I ruled the kingdom and protected the subjects righteously.
